text:
sophia_sales: Heads-up — Prospect DataNest just asked for Net90 + staggered invoicing across a 24-month commitment. They also want the POC to be included in the contract (no separate SOW). Can deal desk + finance weigh in? cc @jordan_dealdesk @timothy_finance :eyes:

jordan_dealdesk: Can you drop the proposed numbers and why Net90 vs our standard Net30? Need to assess discounting pressure and revenue recognition impact.

sophia_sales: Quick context:
- Target ARR if they convert: $450,000/year.
- They're asking to break Year1 into 3 invoices (50% upfront, 25% @6mo, 25% @12mo) OR Net90 on the full invoice.
- They're pushing for a 15% concession if we accept staggered/Net90.
- POC: 4 weeks, dedicated staging, 2 SEs for integration.

anya_se: SE notes: we can run the POC in our dedicated staging cluster. Acceptance criteria to lock in pricing:
- 95th tail latency < 200ms for generate endpoint
- Embeddings throughput >= 250 qps with 10ms median embed latency
- No regression vs baseline for reranking quality (we'll provide eval harness)
We will need a 1-engineer-week included as part of the POC (recommend priced as a line item).

leo_cs: AE says they'll only push this if discount is available — asking for 15% on Year1 if we accept the payment split. Otherwise they're okay with 10% for a pure annual upfront.

timothy_finance: Finance POV: Net90 is non-standard for this ARR. Requirements: credit application + AR review. For >$200k ARR, we need CFO signoff or a revenue reserve. Alternatives to reduce risk:
- Accept staggered invoicing with 50% upfront (wire/ACH), remaining on Net30 terms for later invoices.
- Convert to annual upfront with standard discount (easier for revenue recognition).
If you want Net90 on full amount, expect longer approval (legal + finance) and possible requirement for a payment guarantee.

jordan_dealdesk: Please upload the pricing calc and a short business justification (why Net90 is necessary). Also add whether POC must be free or billable. If POC is included, that affects our amortization schedule. Legal will need DPA + special payment terms clause.

sophia_sales: POC must be included per buyer procurement. They said "no separate SOW" but will accept a POC acceptance milestone clause in the agreement.

irina_security: Security check: We completed their security questionnaire last week and DPA is ready. They asked for pen-test results and SCIM SSO — both ok on our side (pen-test redacted report available, SCIM supported). No security blockers for contract sign.

leo_cs: AE pushed a counter: if we accept staggered invoices + 15% off, they commit to a 3yr auto-renew with 5% annual escalator. That increases CLTV a lot, but shifts cash.

sophia_sales: Proposed payment schedule they suggested (copied from buyer):
```
Invoice 1 (Day 0): 50% of Year1
Invoice 2 (Month 6): 25% of Year1
Invoice 3 (Month 12): 25% of Year1
Year2 & Year3: invoiced annually or quarterly depending on cash flow
```

jordan_dealdesk: If we accept that schedule, I want these controls before approving:
- 50% non-refundable upfront (to reduce churn risk)
- Credit app completed and approved by AR
- CFO signoff for Net terms on any remaining amounts > $100k
- Legal to add late fee / interest and a payment guarantee clause

timothy_finance: Agreed. Also: route through Deal Desk with a revenue reserve line. We can do conditional approval: 50% upfront + remaining on Net90 subject to credit & guarantee. If buyer declines guarantee, escalate to CFO for signoff.

anya_se: Operational note: If POC is included in the contract, tag it as a deliverable milestone (acceptance tests). We'll need staging capacity reserved and a named SE to run the eval. That SE time should be billed into the first invoice or listed as a credit — clarify in SOW.

sophia_sales: I'll ask AE to present 2 options to buyer tomorrow: (A) Annual upfront with 10% discount, (B) Staggered 50/25/25 + 15% discount with the controls Jordan listed. Will push for POC acceptance milestone and SE time either billed or listed as committed services.

jordan_dealdesk: Sounds good. Upload the pricing sheet + POC acceptance wording here and tag legal (legal@redwood.com). If all checks out, deal desk can provision conditional approval :white_check_mark:.

sophia_sales: Will upload in ~2h. Thanks everyone 🙏

leo_cs: FYI buyer finance prefers a single invoice per year but procurement is flexible if we give them the stagger. May help closing velocity.

timothy_finance: Final: we can approve conditional Net90/staggered only with 50% non-refundable upfront + credit app + payment guarantee OR CFO explicit signoff. We'll await the pricing calc.

jordan_dealdesk: Okay, holding for docs. Tag me when uploaded.

sophia_sales: Uploaded pricing calc + proposed contract extract: https://redwood.example/pricing/attachments/1763501234 (private link)

jordan_dealdesk: Got it. I'll start drafting the conditional approval note and loop legal. Thanks all.
